Name: ChocoboMod
Author: D4nkMagician
Description:
[size=5]    [u]Install:
[/u][/size]
      [size=3] [b]If using the main Mod file for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], follow the steps below: [/b][/size]
        1. [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
        2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
        3. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Arial] or just download if using a mod manager like Vortex.[/font]
        4. Configure options by editing the included config.json file, or in game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. 
        5. Run the game using SMAPI!
[list=1]


[size=3][b]﻿If using the [i]optional [/i]files for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url]﻿, follow the steps below: [/b][/size]
 [i] *Note! This file only contains the Chocobo skin files, for use with Adopt 'n' Skin. If using Adopt 'n' Skin, do not download the main mod, only the skins. [/i]
1. Download the optional skins file
2. Extract and place the included "Horse" folder into your AdoptSkin/assets/skins folder 
3. Configure color options 

The Chocobo skin files are listed as Horse_1 - Horse_11 
Horse_1 = Yellow
Horse_2 = Purple
Horse_3 = Silver 
Horse_4 = Brown 
Horse_5 = Blue 
Horse_6 = Red
Horse_7 = Green 
Horse_8 = Black 
Horse_9 = White
Horse_10 = Gold
Horse_11 = Pink 

[i]*Note: Saddles are not available if using Adopt n Skin [/i]

[size=5][u]﻿﻿Configuration:[/u] 
[/size]
[size=3][b]If using the "config.json" file:[/b][/size]
To configure color/saddle choices, edit the included "config.json" file in a text editor like notepad/notepad++ with your desired options. The default values in the config file are for a "Yellow" Chocobo with a "Brown" saddle enabled.

You can choose from the following Chocobo and saddle colors. 
[u]Chocobo color options:[/u] Yellow, Purple, Silver, Brown, Blue, Red, Green, Black, White, Gold, and Pink. 
[u]Saddle color options: [/u]Black, Blue, Brown, Dark Brown, Green, Grey, Light Brown, Pink, Red, and White. 
(If enabled, "SaddleOn" will be set to "true") 

[i]Example Configuration: [/i]
As an example, if you wanted to change the Chocobo color to "Purple" and the saddle color to "White" you would need to edit the config.json file to look like this: 

[list=1]
{[/list][list=1]
  "ColorSelection": "[b]Purple[/b]",[/list][list=1]
  "SaddleOn": "true",[/list][list=1]
  "SaddleColor": "[b]White[/b]",[/list][list=1]
  "MenuIcon": "true"[/list][list=1]
}
[/list]
[size=3][b]If using Generic Mod Config Menu: [/b][/size]
Simply open the ChocoboMod settings in the mod configuration menu and select a color from the available drop down options. 


[/list]
